notes.title: 🐸 Frog Galaxy Survivor is Back!
notes.notes: [p]🐸 Hello, friends![/p][p]You may remember that the original developer, Hunt Games, was forced to pause work on Frog Galaxy Survivor due to difficulties and the large amount of work ahead. This was truly sad news, as the game had already won the hearts of many players with its engaging gameplay and vibrant style. It would be a real shame to leave such a promising project unfinished.[/p][p]💥 That’s why we, the team at Whale Rock Games, decided to give Frog Galaxy Survivor another chance! We’re excited to continue development and bring the game all the way to a full release. Here’s what we have planned:[/p][p]🎮 Completely rework the gameplay foundation, turning it into a truly captivating vampire survivor-like[/p][p]🌌 Add new locations with unique enemies and mechanics[/p][p]🔫 Expand Frogus’s arsenal — expect even more powerful and stylish weapons[/p][p]🎯 Refresh the interface — modern, user-friendly, and pleasing to the eye[/p][p]🛠 Fix bugs and implement many other improvements[/p][p]We’d also love to hear your thoughts: what do you think about the current version of the game, and what do you feel it’s missing? Your feedback will help us shape the game into exactly what you want it to be.[/p][p]Thank you for staying with us. Frog Galaxy Survivor is coming back — and this is just the beginning of its journey![/p][p]🚀 With love,[/p][p]The Whale Rock Games Team[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3083360/Frog_Galaxy_Survivor/?beta=1" style="button"]Add to Wishlist[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31645359/835bcb8e20ef4fca633d6ad883ee9236d3f7f1c2.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.notes:
[b]NeverSynth[/b] is a 3rd person game that is a rhythm-driving simulator.
This game is a dynamic action game in which you have to drive a car to rhythmic music and collect beats. The more beats you collect, the more game points you earn.
